shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -100

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/vite-env.d.ts; echo ---; cat tsconfig.json; echo ---; cat AGENTS.md; echo ---; cat index.html; echo ---; git status --short; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'

cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; echo ----; rg -n -C 4 "Modal|Dialog" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -60; echo ----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head

.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button ConfirmDialog ThemeProvider 2>&1 | head -80; echo ----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/; rg -n -i "confirm" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -20

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button ConfirmDialog 2>&1 | head -60; echo ----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/ | head -50; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md 2>/dev/null

rg -n -C 3 "ConfirmDialog" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm --glob '*.d.ts' | head -40; echo ----; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build -name "*.d.ts" -path "*ConfirmDialog*" ; echo ----; rg -n "ConfirmDialog|Dialog" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head
npm view @gravity-ui/components version peerDependencies 2>&1 | tail -30; echo ----; npm view @gravity-ui/components@latest dependencies --json 2>&1 | head -5

npm view @gravity-ui/components versions --json 2>/dev/null | tail -40; for v in $(npm view @gravity-ui/components versions --json 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[],"' | grep -E '^4\.' | tail -3); do echo "$v:"; npm view @gravity-ui/components@$v peerDependencies --json 2>/dev/null; done

npm view @gravity-ui/components@4 peerDependencies --json 2>/dev/null | tail -30; echo ----; npm view @gravity-ui/components@4.24.1 peerDependencies --json 2>/dev/null; npm view @gravity-ui/components@4.24.1 dependencies --json 2>/dev/null | head -30
for v in 4.23.1 4.23.0 4.22.0; do echo -n "$v uikit peer: "; npm view @gravity-ui/components@$v peerDependencies --json 2>/dev/null | grep uikit; done

npm install --save-exact @gravity-ui/components@4.23.1 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn Unknown env" | tail -15; echo ----; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/components/package.json node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json; cat package.json | head -20; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/components/; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/components/build 2>/dev/null | head
find node_modules/@gravity-ui/components/build -iname "*confirm*" | head; echo ----; rg -n -i "confirm" node_modules/@gravity-ui/components/README.md | head -20

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/components/build/esm/components/ConfirmDialog/ConfirmDialog.d.ts; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/components/build/esm/components/ConfirmDialog/ConfirmDialog.js | head -80; echo ----; rg -n "ConfirmDialog" node_modules/@gravity-ui/components/build/esm/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/components/build/esm/components/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null

rg -n "components|export" node_modules/@gravity-ui/components/build/esm/index.d.ts | head; echo ----; rg -n -i -A8 "required setup|setup|import" node_modules/@gravity-ui/components/README.md | head -60; echo ----; rg -n "open|onClose|size" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Dialog/Dialog.d.ts | head -20

rg -n "view\?|view:" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -5; rg -n "ButtonView" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5; rg -n "spacing" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Box/Box.d.ts | head -5; rg -n "onClickButtonApply|onClickButtonCancel" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Dialog/*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Dialog/**/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5
npm run build 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -40
cat .gitignore; echo ----; git status --short; echo ----; git diff --stat; grep -n '"@gravity-ui' package.json
